patterns.note: The site employs a high-contrast, vibrant color palette with a dramatic background color shift from dark teal to bright cyan as the user scrolls down the page.
A playful, handwritten-style display font is used for prominent headings and the brand logo, creating a distinctive and personal voice, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text.
The hero section features an asymmetrical composition with a large, stylized portrait and whimsical 3D illustrations (palm trees, flamingo, tiger) that break typical grid structures.
Hero section elements, including the portrait, main heading, and 3D palm trees, parallax at varying speeds against the background as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
The page background transitions from a dark teal to a bright cyan at a specific scroll depth, marking a clear visual division between the hero and subsequent content sections.
The very bottom of the page is anchored by a full-width, vibrant hot pink 'paint splatter' graphic, adding a final touch of playful irreverence.

technique_notes: The background color transition is achieved by a scroll-triggered animation that changes the background property of a main container or the body element at a predefined scroll position.

The hero section utilizes a multi-layered parallax effect where different elements (foreground portrait and text, mid-ground 3D objects) are animated to move at distinct speeds relative to the scroll position, enhancing visual depth.

Typography establishes a clear hierarchy by using an oversized, bold, and decorative display font for key headings, while body text is set in a highly legible sans-serif with generous line spacing for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, handwritten-style headings (~3-4x body) create a strong visual statement, while body text is a standard, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for most elements, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and a distinct circular outline for the hero portrait.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is very airy with ample negative space, transitioning to a more balanced density in content sections, maintaining good line and paragraph spacing for readability.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its audacious and unconventional aesthetic, combining a high-contrast, almost neon color palette with whimsical 3D illustrations and a personal, handwritten typographic style. It actively subverts typical 'boring' website design, creating a memorable and playful brand identity that feels genuinely unique.
